hooks.text: 点击既是采集、战斗和经营资源，但每天总共只有 20 次
hooks.excerpt: Use clicks to harvest resources, fight enemies and manage your village, but use them wisely as you only get 20 clicks every day!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 点击树木、敌人与迷雾执行不同动作，建筑还能把单次点击放大为更多产出
hooks.excerpt: For example, click a tree to get wood, click enemies to damage them or click the fog to reveal more of the map. Use structures to get the maximum out of your clicks. For example, build a quarry that automatically mines 3 stone per click or build click factories to obtain more clicks.
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

hooks.text: 每局赚取商店金币，用来购买新塔和快速点击等升级延长生存
hooks.excerpt: Each run gives you coins to spend in the shop. Buy new towers and upgrades like rapid click to survive longer!
hooks.label: 证据原文片段

excerpts.excerpt: 每个建筑和敌人都设计得十分可爱
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

excerpts.excerpt: The tower defense aspect of it isn't great either.
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 玩法循环很快变得重复且缺乏刺激

excerpts.excerpt: very quickly it became apparent how repetitive and unexciting the gameplay loop is
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 防御塔有时无法识别近身敌人

excerpts.excerpt: 我旁边围着的一圈防御塔都认不出来那是怪
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 部分建筑强度失衡且没有建造价值

excerpts.excerpt: 别的一些建筑 (尤其是弱的塔)，可以说不明所以，完全没有造的必要
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

excerpts.excerpt: 中后期 50 到 100 波感觉比较重复
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 后半段体验枯燥且回报不足

excerpts.excerpt: the rest was dull and tedious and unrewarding
excerpts.label: 证据原文片段

opinions.text: 塔防与资源管理融合得很出色

excerpts.excerpt: An incredible blend of tower defense strategy & resource management
